purpose: Measure V3 parsing, retrieval, reranking, routing, answer generation, citations, verdicts, formatting, and latency with controlled and realistic user language.

execution_policy.retrieval_only: Run every document case with should_retrieve=true after V3 artifact IDs are attached. Do not call an LLM.

execution_policy.e2e_extended: Run only after reviewing the core results and provider quota.
